claim: Theravada Buddhist traditions, including Sri Lanka, use bhavana for a broad field of contemplative cultivation in which samatha and vipassana are major meditation modes supported by guidance, recollection, devotion and related practices.
bounded_by: This establishes meditation as a substantial Theravada practice complex; it does not equate a Dhyana mudra with actual meditation practice and does not prove borrowing from Shaiva traditions.
notes: Run34 forced resolution of the former creolisation draft. The proposition is deliberately narrower than 'meditation is the same or equally central in Buddhism and Shaivism'.
